# I'm Frustrated

> Free legal information and self-help tools for people frustrated with bureaucratic, legal, and administrative systems.

I'm Frustrated is a nonprofit resource for people navigating frustrating systems — appeals, denials, complaints, and self-represented advocacy — without an attorney.

It is a New York nonprofit that publishes free legal information, guides, template letters, and self-help tools. It is not a law firm and does not give legal advice. Using it does not create an attorney-client relationship.
